notes.title: TKotCT artbook — an unhelpful guide and a sneak peek
notes.content: Every princess deserves to be pretty when coming to a fair. So we made this pretty little DLC for Lady Laura — and you! — to enjoy the summer festivities in full! "An Unhelpful Guide" is a mix between art- and lorebook of the world of the KotCT and acts as a teaser to the upcoming stories as well as to the ones already told in other DLCs. And it's completely free! Hope you enjoy this little gift from the team!

notes.title: Guests at the Threshold DLC is finally out!
notes.content: We're happy to announce the release of the third DLC for the Knight of the Crimson Tower, [i]Guests at the Threshold[/i]! Meet some new characters and learn something new about the world they live in and the magic that flows through it.

notes.title: "The Hunter's Moon" DLC is out!
notes.content:
The Hunter's Moon tells a story about mysterious Watchers that guard the world lady Laura lives in. What was so terrifying about her gift? Is it the first time it slips into this world? And who holds the line when it does?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183850/The_Knight_of_the_Crimson_Tower__The_Hunters_Moon/]Play the new DLC[/url] and find out!
